note: Each great power's unique units, building and wonder (v2 step 4), unlocked by its goals. A unit is a company with its own power, cost and upkeep and one ability: `move` adds march points to an army made only of companies that have it; `siege` takes a turn off a siege; `defend` multiplies its strength when it holds a city or castle; `spy` lets its army enter any realm's land without war. A building is raised once, with production, in its city; a wonder once in the world. Their `yields` add to that city; `realm` changes the whole realm: `companyCost` (a multiplier), `integration` (more a month for conquered cities), `defend` (the realm's walled places hold harder), `love` and `renown` (a month), `movePoints` (more marches for every army).
